summary: Trusted Onboarding Engine schema (Issue #15), extending the 452 conversion staging tables. Creates append-only onboarding_artifacts (immutable source intake) and onboarding_stage_events (ordered by seq; completions carry status + open controls; waivers, approvals and advances must be human and bound to the LATEST completion of the current stage, validated on insert; a waiver covers one open control once, with a reason). conversion_batches gains onboarding_stage / write_locked / approved_preflight_sha256 with a guard trigger that re-proves the gate on every stage change: one step forward, PASS or every open control human-waived for the latest completion, execute only with a human approval of the current preflight result; write lock open only in execute. Staged rows can reference an artifact; conversion_runs.run_kind widened; control results record level, declared tolerance (needs a reason) and a WAIVED disposition that never changes status. No rows change; existing batches (stage NULL) are untouched.

preflight.name: onboarding tables do not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('onboarding_artifacts','onboarding_stage_events')

preflight.name: conversion_batches has no onboarding columns yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'conversion_batches' AND column_name IN ('onboarding_stage','write_locked','approved_preflight_sha256')

expected_changes: Creates onboarding_artifacts (append-only; SELECT/INSERT grants; UNIQUE(batch_id, sha256); sha256/bytes/record_ownership CHECKs).

Creates onboarding_stage_events (append-only; seq identity; completion_event_id self-FK; CHECKs human_gates, bound_to_completion, completion_result, advance_target, waiver_reason, approval_hash) + insert trigger trg_onboarding_stage_events_validate.

Creates functions onboarding_append_only, onboarding_next_stage, onboarding_completion_gate, onboarding_stage_events_validate, conversion_batches_onboarding_guard + trigger trg_conversion_batches_onboarding_guard.
Adds conversion_batches.onboarding_stage (nullable), write_locked (default true), approved_preflight_sha256 + CHECKs onboarding_stage_check and write_lock_only_in_execute.
Adds conversion_staged_rows.artifact_id (FK), canonical_domain, source_locator, raw_source; relaxes source_file_id to nullable with CHECK conversion_staged_rows_has_source.
Replaces conversion_runs_run_kind_check to allow the stage run kinds.

Adds conversion_control_results.level, tolerance_cents, tolerance_reason (CHECK tolerance_declared) and disposition, waived_by, waiver_reason, waived_at, waiver_event_id (CHECK waiver_disposition: WAIVED only on FAIL/BLOCKED with who/why/when/event).
